storybook.description: Hardcover opening, curved page turns and per-page explanation.

spotlight.description: Five-card fan-out, hero focus and return to a full lineup.

launch.description: Dark launch film with screenshot collage, feature close-ups and CTA.

orbit.description: Neon orbital gallery, rotating screenshot depth and a cinematic final lineup.

kinetic.description: Bold kinetic typography, alternating split screens and graphic wipes.

prism.description: Hinged accordion screens, layered glass reveals and prismatic light sweeps.

flipstack.description: Shared-spine multi-leaf riffle with a continuous camera push and front-facing page reveal.

entrance.description: Gentle fan-shaped upward card entrances with side introductions, wide fan-out and a lifted center card.
